C-KAFEDRA-WORKSPACE-SKILLS-288.Summary: Integrate the pinned Kafedra Planner document-workspace skill profile as a repository-local, fail-closed routing layer for all future substantial development without changing product runtime behavior.
C-KAFEDRA-WORKSPACE-SKILLS-288.Problem: The reusable Kafedra document-workspace profile exists in f2re/ai-agents-skills, but Kafedra Planner does not yet vendor the profile or require its orchestrator before future development, so document workflow, provenance, review-by-exception, partial-success, adaptive-control and motion rules can be applied inconsistently.

Goals.Goal: Vendor the complete 14-skill Kafedra profile from f2re/ai-agents-skills commit 2645ab8afd34963e80397981d582ea3b141db8e3 with exact Git-blob provenance.
Make kafedra-workspace-orchestrator an explicit repository development preflight while keeping AGENTS.md, GRACE 4 and existing repository-local specialist roles authoritative.
Connect the reusable profile to the existing flow, design, motion, feature, independent design-audit and test handoff chain without creating a competing lifecycle.
Add a dependency-free deterministic validator and regression tests that fail when the pinned snapshot, routing markers or role handoffs are removed or altered.
Document an explicit, reviewable update procedure so a later upstream profile revision is never pulled silently.

Constraints.Constraint: The existing GRACE 4 lifecycle remains the outer governance mechanism and approved ObservedWriteScope cannot be widened silently.
Project-local AGENTS.md, domain documentation and existing kafedra specialist roles outrank reusable profile defaults.
No production UI, API, storage, schema, migration, VERSION, package runtime dependency or product workflow may change.
The integrated profile must be available offline from the repository and must not require network access, a remote agent service, Docker or an LLM.
Only the Kafedra-specific profile is vendored; meteorological and unrelated generic skills are not imported automatically.
Profile updates require a new reviewed commit pin, manifest update and successful deterministic verification.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Redesign any existing Kafedra Planner screen or user flow in this change.
Replace kafedra-flow-intake, kafedra-design, kafedra-motion, kafedra-feature, kafedra-design-audit, kafedra-tests, kafedra-data or kafedra-release with external agents.
Install the whole ai-agents-skills repository, its installer, integrations or meteorological profile into Kafedra Planner.
Introduce a runtime plugin mechanism or automatic network synchronization of skills.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Exactly fourteen pinned Kafedra profile SKILL.md files are present under codex/skills and each Git blob matches the manifest sourced from ai-agents-skills commit 2645ab8afd34963e80397981d582ea3b141db8e3.
AGENTS.md requires kafedra-workspace-orchestrator preflight for substantial development and states that project-local authority and GRACE 4 remain stronger than reusable profile defaults.
docs/CODEX_AGENTS.md documents selective routing from the orchestrator into existing project roles rather than loading the whole profile for every task.
The existing flow, design, motion, feature, independent design-audit and test skills contain explicit handoff/reference points to the workspace profile where relevant.
docs/KAFEDRA_SKILLS_PROFILE.md records upstream repository, exact commit, skill set, authority rules and a safe manual update procedure.
A dependency-free validator verifies manifest provenance, all fourteen local Git-blob hashes, orchestrator/routing markers and required role handoffs.
Regression tests prove the validator fails when an orchestrator skill, pinned skill bytes or mandatory routing marker is missing or changed.
npm run check, npm run docs:check and the GRACE target/final gates pass, and existing project/release/offline/database CI remains green on one exact PR head.
Delivery uses a normal PR, exact-head squash merge, post-merge CI and a separate archive-only terminal applied transition.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The local manifest and Git-blob verification prove the reusable profile is pinned and intact while unchanged-head GRACE, project, release, offline and database checks prove no runtime surface was altered.

Assumptions.Assumption: The verified base revision is main commit 67c2506ae03ac3543589b4f500a519eb808f90a6 with tree 20100a227491f8b62a92e877aceb415e6a5b144c.
Issue 288 is the human-visible work item for this change.
The verified upstream profile commit is 2645ab8afd34963e80397981d582ea3b141db8e3 and contains fourteen Kafedra-specific SKILL.md files.
